verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is a terminal-based coding agent. First-party docs show it querying and editing large codebases, taking CLI flags like `--include-directories` and `--output-format`, running non-interactively, and offering slash commands. Hands-on users confirm running it locally against large codebases (it requires a Node runtime), though others report agentic reliability problems such as loops and failed edits, and some say Google is winding the tool down. missing for 10: explicit local install/setup documentation in the evidence, consistent hands-on reliability of agentic edits, clarity on continued availability given the sunset reports.
